seed_weights: History recency/frequency scores normalized across the 10 most recently purchased distinct SKUs; uniform if their sum is zero.
tie_break: Ascending normalized SKU; seed recency ties also use ascending SKU.
interleaving: Choose active source minimizing (unique emissions + 1) / share, ties use source_order. Consume duplicate heads without emitting; deactivate exhausted sources; continue until cap or exhaustion. Integer cross-products compare priorities exactly. Remaining shares implicitly renormalize. Ablations omit one source and use the same procedure.
personalized_ranker: Previously purchased items first by descending history score, then SKU. Never-purchased items follow by descending recent distinct-customer popularity, then SKU.
popularity_ranker: Descending recent distinct-customer popularity then SKU, including zero-popularity items when ranking a candidate pool or the full known catalog.
primary_target: Distinct repeat + discovery SKUs within the cutoff catalog; outside_catalog labels are diagnostic only.
primary_macro_population: Queries with at least one primary target. Other queries remain in candidate/recommendation/coverage artifacts and segment counts, but contribute no undefined target metrics.
ndcg: Binary DCG at ranks 1..10 discounted by 1/log2(rank+1). IDCG uses min(10, full primary target size), including missed positives outside the pool.
recall: Distinct hits divided by the full target size. Segment recall averages only queries with a nonempty repeat/discovery segment. Empty recommendation/candidate lists score zero when the target segment is nonempty; empty target segments are null and excluded from that segment's macro mean.
oracle: For each prefix pool K, put min(10, number of distinct primary positives in that pool) positives first. Full primary target defines IDCG and recall denominators. Oracle order is used for evaluation only, never candidate generation.
catalog_coverage: Per cutoff, fraction of visible catalog SKUs returned across all eligible queries. Report candidate-prefix coverage and top-10 recommendation coverage for each baseline; never union catalogs from different cutoffs as a denominator.
standalone: Report each baseline's top 10 from the entire visible catalog, independent of candidate restrictions.
heldout_policy: Validation and test are not evaluated by this runner. These initial definitions are recorded before inspecting training retrieval outcomes. No ML training or outcome-based policy tuning.
